offering_description.value: Supplies home medical equipment and recurring medical supplies to patients managing chronic conditions. It delivers equipment and supplies through local branches and direct shipping, provides in-home respiratory care, and bills health plans and public insurance programs.

primary_products.value: Home oxygen and ventilation equipment; sleep apnea devices and supplies; diabetes monitoring and insulin delivery supplies; wound and ostomy supplies; urological and incontinence supplies

primary_services.value: In-home respiratory therapy; home medical equipment rental; equipment setup and patient training

customer_segment.value: B2C: Patients using home medical equipment or recurring medical supplies and their caregivers; B2B: Commercial health plans and managed care organizations

end_markets.value: Home healthcare; respiratory care; sleep apnea care; diabetes care; wound and continence care

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Public and private insurance payments for covered equipment, supplies and home respiratory care; product sales: Home medical devices and recurring supplies purchased by patients; rental or leasing: Home oxygen, ventilation and other durable medical equipment rentals
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; product sales; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: distributor: Sources devices and consumables from manufacturers and ships them directly to patients; service provider: Uses respiratory clinicians and medical equipment to provide care in patients’ homes

specialization.value: related lines: Home respiratory and sleep equipment, diabetes supplies, wound and ostomy supplies, and urological supplies

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Patient intake and telephone ordering with direct home delivery; own locations: Local home medical equipment branches for delivery, setup and service; online: Patient portals for ordering and replenishing supplies; other: Referrals from prescribers, hospital discharge planners and health plans
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; online; other

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Medicare durable medical equipment supplier accreditation and enrollment, plus applicable state licensing for equipment and respiratory care
